preconditions.description: Number of cities is within the specified range.
Number of plans is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each city's mineral resource is within the specified range.
There are exactly n-1 edges forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and 1 <= l_i <= r_i <= n for u_i, v_i, l_i, r_i in plans)
preconditions.description: Each plan's parameters are within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of plans.

postconditions.expression: all(c_i in range(-1, n+1) for c_i in output)
postconditions.description: Each output value is either -1 or a valid mineral resource label.

postconditions.expression: all((c_i == -1 or (a_i % 2 == 1 and l_i <= c_i <= r_i)) for (u_i, v_i, l_i, r_i), c_i, a_i in zip(plans, output, a))
postconditions.description: For each plan, if c_i is not -1, it appears an odd number of times between u_i and v_i and is within the specified range [l_i, r_i].
